scope: 前端本地存储与持久化方案调研
content: IndexedDB is a low-level API for client-side storage of significant amounts of structured data, including files/blobs... While Web Storage is useful for storing smaller amounts of data, it is less useful for storing larger amounts of structured data. IndexedDB provides a solution.
conclusion: IndexedDB是浏览器原生支持的结构化对象存储，支持大容量存储、结构化克隆算法及异步事务操作，并在Web Workers中可用，非常适合PWA离线数据存储。
